content: Hello! I am a junior student of Rutgers . I've been working on formalizing Bourbaki strict maps and some properties of quotient maps (issue #36269). I would like to open a PR for my new file Mathlib/Topology/Maps/Strict.lean. How to submit the pr? Do I need write access to the mathlib4 repository? My GitHub username is zw810-ctrl.

Hello! :wave:
See Git Guide for Mathlib4 Contributors

Hey there, you should consider linking your github username to your zulip!

Also, I can't seem to find it anywhere in your fork : https://github.com/zw810-ctrl/mathlib4/tree/master/Mathlib/Topology , have you pushed the change?

First perhaps sync your fork, then once you add your file, you can open the PR to push your changes via opening a PR of your forked version against master on the upstream.
